jobs.title: Project Management Lead
jobs.description_text: Overview Do you ever wish the rest of the world was as organized as you are? Are you the person people go to because you are dependable, can figure out anything that comes your way, and can carry a large volume of very different projects at once? We are looking for someone ready to serve at the heart of our ministry, driving execution from idea to market. Our project managers are the operational backbone between all of our internal and external teams. As a Project Management Lead, you turn new ideas and marketing initiatives into clearly specified tasks, keep that work moving on time by removing roadblocks, and ensure that all customer-facing resources are quality-tested to provide a world-class experience. No two days as a Dynamic Catholic Project Manager look the same, and that is the fun of it! From kicking off new projects with internal team members, to scheduling out a year-long marketing campaign, to quality testing an email going to donors all over the country, each day will bring new experiences and challenges. You will work alongside our leadership team to see every project through, from first idea to finished product. If you’re a type A, detail-oriented, quick learner who loves turning big ideas into finished work, and who will roll up your sleeves and pitch in wherever needed, this is the job for you! jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise-wide view of risk, including its Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders. The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.
